title: A site build that hangs ends: the host stops provision after 15 silent or 60 total minutes, the sweep fails a build still running after 75 minutes, and the wizard says when it cannot reach the build or the build is gone
steps: S1: runScript a script that prints once then sleeps, with idleMs 300; and one that prints every 100 ms for a second.
S2: runProvisionJob with a run that answers timedOut and idle.

S3: settleProvisions on a creation whose host job answers running, at 30 minutes and past PROVISION_GIVE_UP_MS; and on one whose host does not answer, at 60 minutes and past PROVISION_UNREACHABLE_GIVE_UP_MS.
S4: watchBuild over a door that answers unknown for more than UNREACHABLE_SAY_MS then running; and one that answers gone.
expect: S1: the first is stopped by the silence (idle: true, a log line saying so); the second runs to its end.
S2: run was given timeoutMs 60 min and idleMs 15 min; the job fails with reason idle and a detail naming the silence.
S3: left alone inside the limits; failed (reason timeout / host-unreachable) and the creation settled past them.
S4: unreachable true after two minutes, asking goes on, false once an answer lands; the gone build shows the form with the note 'gone'.
evidence: provision.js ran provision.sh with no timeoutMs; cron skipped running jobs for ever; the client polled with no cap. Local stand: "fetching webroot" ran 1110 s then failed; EmDash docker builds sat 29 and 49 minutes until the host restarted
fence: Three layers each end a hung build; the host's silence limit does the real work, above the longest healthy build

tests: runScript: idleMs stops a run that went silent
a provision has a total limit and a silence limit
the sweep gives up on a build still running 75 minutes
watch: two minutes of unanswered asks are said on the console
watch: a build that is gone says so on the form
